 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Topstories News PCSO Lotto Results: Lone Lotto 6/42 winner gets P26.9M in November 19, 2026 draw 
 By GMA News Published November 19, 2026 11:15pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. A Lotto 6/42 bettor won over P26.9 richer in the November 19, 2026 draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Thursday evening.
 The winning Lotto 6/42 numbers of 15-40-08-34-23-10 unlocked a jackpot prize totaling P26,912,539.06.
 Meanwhile, there was no winner for Superlotto 6/49 and its P120,557,444.82 prize. The correct combination was 23-24-10-02-09-37.
 Click here for the complete lotto results. — BAP, GMA News
